content: {"summary":"To verify whether PostgreSQL is still serving the old certificate, fetch the server’s presented cert with openssl s_client and compare its serial (or end date) to the local /etc/postgresql/16/main/server.crt file. If the serials differ, the DB is using the old cert. Reload the configuration (SELECT pg_reload_conf(); or systemctl reload postgresql) to make it pick up the new files. The replica (auth-db-02) has its own certificate and timer and must be reloaded in the same way.","likely_cause":"PostgreSQL was not reloaded after the certificate files were renewed, so it continued serving the previous certificate.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"To compare the certificate served by PostgreSQL with the file on disk, run openssl s_client against the DB port and compare its serial with the local server.crt file.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#2"],"quote":"Compare what the server sends with what is on disk:"},{"text":"If the serial numbers differ, PostgreSQL is still presenting the old certificate.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#2"],"quote":"Different serials mean the server is still on the old certificate."},{"text":"Reload PostgreSQL configuration to load the new certificate without a full restart.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#2"],"quote":"Reload, don't restart: SELECT pg_reload_conf();"},{"text":"The replica auth-db-02 also requires its own certificate and must be reloaded similarly.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#3"],"quote":"Does the replica need the same? Yes."},{"text":"PostgreSQL only reads the certificate files at start or when configuration is reloaded.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#1"],"quote":"Postgres reads ssl_cert_file and ssl_key_file when it starts and when its configuration is reloaded."},{"text":"In the April 2025 incident, the renewal timer wrote a new cert but PostgreSQL was not told to reload it.","evidence_ids":["RB-024#4"],"quote":"nothing told Postgres to load it."}],"next_checks":["Run the openssl comparison command on auth-db-01 and auth-db-02 to verify serial mismatch","Execute SELECT pg_reload_conf(); on both primary and replica and confirm reload succeeded","Check that the pg-cert-renew.timer has created fresh server.crt files on both nodes","Inspect PostgreSQL logs for reload events after running pg_reload_conf()","Verify auth-service connections succeed after reload"]}
